high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from TechCrunch.com, dated 12:45, as indicated by the time at the top of the screen. The website's header includes the TechCrunch logo on the left and a search icon along with a menu icon on the right. The article discusses Baiju Bhatt, who stepped away from his role as chief creative officer at Robinhood last year. It mentions that only those close to him could have predicted his next move—launching a space company built around technology that the aerospace industry has largely dismissed but which might be more groundbreaking than anyone realizes.
